prompt:
THE BACKGROUND MUST BE FLAT SOLID MAGENTA #FF00FF, filling every pixel behind the group, edge to edge. THE BACKGROUND IS NOT WHITE, NOT CREAM, NOT A ROOM, NOT A LIBRARY, NOT SHELVES, NOT A WALL, NOT A FLOOR, NOT A RUG, NOT A WINDOW. If you are about to render any room or any pale background, RENDER PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF INSTEAD. No shadow on the backdrop, no ground plane under them, no frame, no border, no text, no watermark. The magenta must be visible BETWEEN and AROUND every figure, including the gaps between their arms and bodies.

A SEATED GROUP, CUT OUT, seen from slightly BEHIND AND TO ONE SIDE — we are looking past the children toward the storyteller. The whole group sits low and wide across the bottom of the frame, with plenty of empty magenta above their heads.

On the RIGHT, a kind woman in her fifties sits in a low wooden chair, turned three-quarters toward the children and toward us: warm brown skin, dark hair streaked with silver pinned up loosely, small round spectacles, a deep TEAL-GREEN cardigan over a warm MUSTARD-GOLD dress, a soft OLIVE shawl across her lap. An open book rests on her knee and one hand is lifted mid-sentence, palm turned up, telling.

On the LEFT and in front of her, FOUR YOUNG CHILDREN sit cross-legged on the floor with their BACKS AND SHOULDERS toward us, faces turned away toward her, listening. Their clothes are warm and saturated — RUST-RED, DEEP BLUE, AMBER-GOLD, PLUM — with different hair colours and skin tones between them. One child rests their chin in both hands. No child's face is fully visible; we see the backs of their heads and a little of their profiles.

Warm hand-illustrated storybook style with clean flat shapes and soft painted shading, matching the reference figures exactly in proportion, line weight and palette warmth. Cosy, hushed, attentive. Every garment saturated and warm — no white, no cream, no pale fabric anywhere. The group is a CUT-OUT on FLAT MAGENTA #FF00FF with nothing behind it.
